Looking for a break from the ordinary, I set out to find something different and fun. I thought about SkyBlock, and came across ASkyBlock and AcidIsland plugins by the same author. They are quite popular and the author is very active for both plugins.

ASkyBlock

You find yourself marooned on an island in the sky with just a cow and a chest of strange items. Don't fall! Moo!

  • Use the /island cp command to get started.

AcidIsland

You're on an island, in a sea of acid! If you like Skyblock, try AcidIsland for a new challenge!

This is a variation on my popular ASkyBlock plugin. Instead of falling, you must contend with acid water when expanding your island and players can boat to each other's islands.

  • Use the /ai cp command to get started.

Inventories are saved between world groups (overworld+nether+end, skyblock+nether, acidisland+nether) so there's no fear of having your inventory wiped out. Money balance is also different across the same world groups. You can make your SkyBlock or AcidIsland islands publicly visitable by placing a sign with "[WELCOME]" somewhere on the island.

Like with anything else that I've added to this server, you're not compelled to play these games. You can ignore this addition and pretend it never happened. Like it? Hate it? Let me know.
